title: History of the Halvorsen Bridge
text: The Halvorsen Bridge was completed in 1962. It spans the Norrvik Strait and was designed by Ingrid Halvorsen. Construction began in 1958 and employed 400 workers.

title: Halvorsen Bridge traffic report
text: The Halvorsen Bridge carries 12,000 vehicles per day. Counts are taken each spring by the Norrvik transport office.

title: Maintenance schedule for the Halvorsen Bridge
text: Inspection of the Halvorsen Bridge takes place every five years. The last repainting of the steel deck was finished in 2015.

title: The Eastgate Bridge
text: The Eastgate Bridge was completed in 1975. It links the old town with the container port.

title: The Westgate Bridge
text: The Westgate Bridge was completed in 1981. It replaced a ferry that ran for two centuries.

title: The Lindqvist Footbridge
text: The Lindqvist Footbridge was completed in 1998. It crosses the Alder canal and is open to cyclists.

title: Marsh Road Bridge
text: Marsh Road Bridge was completed in 1954. It is the oldest crossing still in use in the district.

title: Skerry Lighthouse
text: Skerry Lighthouse was built in 1893. Its tower is 31 metres tall and its lamp is visible for 18 miles.

title: Skerry Lighthouse height
text: Retracted: this item has been retracted by the publisher and should not be relied on. Skerry Lighthouse is 41 metres tall.

title: Norra Fyr
text: Norra Fyr was built in 1911. It guards the northern approach and was automated in 1967.

title: Harrow Point Light
text: Harrow Point Light was built in 1874. Visitors may climb the 140 steps in summer.

title: Norrvik tunnel tolls
text: The Norrvik tunnel toll is 2 euros for a car. Lorries pay 6 euros.

title: Norrvik tunnel tolls (revised)
text: Revised edition. This version supersedes the earlier Norrvik tunnel tolls. The Norrvik tunnel toll is 3 euros for a car. Lorries pay 8 euros.

title: Norrvik tunnel tolls (reprint)
text: Revised edition. This version supersedes the earlier Norrvik tunnel tolls. The Norrvik tunnel toll is 3 euros for a car. Lorries pay 8 euros.

title: Lantern Festival programme
text: The Lantern Festival opens on the first Friday of October. Entry is free and food stalls line the harbour front.

title: Kite Day
text: Kite Day takes place on the northern beach. Prizes are given for the largest and the smallest kite.

title: Jazz on the Quay
text: Jazz on the Quay runs for three evenings. The main stage sits beside the ferry terminal.

title: Visiting the harbour
text: The harbour is open to walkers all year. Boat trips leave from the ferry terminal every hour in summer.

title: Maritime Museum
text: The Maritime Museum holds a collection of ship models. It is closed on Mondays and open until six on other days.

title: School board election
text: The school board election was held in November. Turnout was 41 percent.

title: Library opening hours
text: The central library opens at nine. It closes at eight on weekdays and at four on Saturdays.

title: Fish market
text: The fish market opens before dawn. Stalls are allocated by lottery each January.

title: Ferry timetable
text: Ferries to the islands leave every hour. The last departure in winter is at five.

title: Town digest, November 2024
text: Digest of town notices. Road works near the station continue until spring. The recycling centre has new opening hours.
